goal: Make the SPA frontend deploy to the dev/prd App Services repeatable via a committed Kudu deploy script + runbook.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Script syntax is valid and invoking it with no args (or --help) prints usage and exits non-zero
deploy-spa.sh dev --dry-run builds, zips dist, and injects deploy/config.dev.js (which contains parametros: true) WITHOUT uploading
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: bash scripts/deploy-spa.sh dev --dry-run; grep parametros dist/config.js

acceptance_criteria.criterion: deploy-spa.sh prd without --yes refuses (exits non-zero, no upload)
No stubs/placeholders; docs/DEPLOY.md documents dev (script) and the separate prod $web pipeline

tasks.desc: scripts/deploy-spa.sh — parametrized dev|prd Kudu deploy with prd guard + dry-run
